C.name: Story Keeper
text: Every story needs a beginning. Will you help light the reading nook?

choices.label: I will help.
choices.text: Thank you! Find the golden bookmark, then walk through the east gate.

choices.label: Tell me more.
choices.text: A bookmark is waiting below the path. The east gate opens when you collect it.

branches.text: A beginning, a choice, and an ending. What will you write next?
You found it! The reading nook is through the east gate.

?.name: An unfinished page
text: This room is written in studio.json. Each letter has a meaning in its legend.
Try moving a letter, rewriting a line, or adding a new room. The game engine can stay exactly as it is.

K.name: Golden bookmark
K.text: You found a golden bookmark. The east gate can open now.

G.locked_text: The gate needs a golden bookmark. Look below the path.
